value.rationale: The automorphism representation on second homology of the smallest nonplanar complete bipartite graph three-braid configuration space is a natural structural invariant, not recoverable from known rank eight. The exact multiplicity-free split into two inequivalent 4D rational irreducibles, nine class values and absence of fixed classes give complete meaningful symmetry information. No unsupported infinite-family generalization is asserted.
